Criterion: Verify that all operator and maintenance manuals containing diagnostic systems are complete and accurate. Standard: Operation and maintenance manuals reflect the appropriate engineering data to ensure diagnostic systems address safety of flight parameters. Method of Compliance: All manuals have undergone quality assurance review by the contractor, and final versions of the manuals have been verified by the Government. References: JSSG-2000: 3.6.2 14 CFR 23.1301, 23.1309, 23.1351, 25.1301, 25.1309, 25.1351
